findings.summary: Share checked PowerShell execution and content-identified dependency reuse between Android and iOS; require complete artifact outputs before recording a reusable build.
Use one generated-main signature adapter for Android and iOS instead of duplicating the entry dispatch template.
Reuse bounded file reads, atomic staging, extension parsing and immutable selected-file snapshots in the UIKit adapter.
Compose desktop and Simulator measured-run environments through one helper, preserving registry timing, replay and override precedence.
Remove unreachable dual-backend Simulator smoke branches and redundant stamp refresh after an already-stamped Dawn generation.
Reuse a single checked SDK-version query for admission, dependency identity and the iOS build receipt.
Keep completed-byte export behind the shared PAL save operation instead of imposing desktop destination-path ordering on UIKit file providers.

Reuse the shared mobile package runner and existing shipping dependency predicates for iOS; SkipGenerate also reuses precompiled Metal so a release batch does not repeat shader generation inside each package.

Share Android/iOS color-font glyph caching, premultiplied textures, effects and ownership instead of duplicating the font engine; keep JNI and CoreText rasterization behind one typed pixel record and reuse FreeType resource ownership.
